<thought>Based on the most intense ion at m/z 276.0666 (likely [M+H]⁺), the neutral mass is ≈275.059 Da. The isotopic pattern (≈16 % M+1) suggests about 13–14 carbons. A formula that matches the exact mass and gives an integer double‑bond equivalent is C₁₃H₉NO₆ (neutral mass 275.059 Da). This fits the observed spectrum and satisfies chemical valence rules.</thought>
<final_answer>C13H9O6N</final_answer>
